definitions.hz: Kopparapu et al. 2014 (ApJL 787 L29), 1 M_earth coefficients; P(conservative) + 0.5 P(optimistic only)
definitions.terrestrial_atm: P(R_p < 1.5 R_earth [Kempton et al. 2018 bin] AND atmosphere side of the cosmic shoreline)
definitions.observable: TSM (Kempton et al. 2018, PASP, doi:10.1088/1538-3873/aadf6f) / follow-up cut, capped at 1; 0 for non-transiting planets
definitions.retention_definition: P(atmosphere side of the cosmic shoreline): I_XUV = I (L/L_sun)^-0.6 (Zahnle & Catling 2017 eq. 27) vs I0 v_esc^4, log10 I0 ~ U(log10 7e-4, -3); XUV scaling scatter 0.48 dex; see validate_shoreline.py

note: A ranking with stated weights for transmission follow-up; not a probability of habitability. The molecule model and the vetting scores are not inputs to the score.
